notes.title: HUGE Update Beta v0.2.0 is here!
notes.notes:
Welcome to a new world! Have fun in a new map with TONS of new Weapons and Weapon Skins! Enjoy the latest balance changes and destroy your opponents in a brand new way!

[u][b]Beta v0.2.0 Patch Notes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] New Weapon! Try out the Revolver! Face off at high noon against your opponents!
[*] New Weapon! Try out the Double Barreled Shotgun! Ever wanted to tell someone to get off your lawn? Well now you can! Devastate your enemies with a shotgun that packs a punch!
[*] New Weapon! Try out the AUG! Burst down your opponents with this firm and robust assault rifle!
[*] New Weapon! Try out the AK-47! Always wanted to use traditional weapons? Mow away your enemies with a blast from the present!
[*] New Weapon! Try out the Super Acid Charger! A new experimental weapon designed to melt your opponents faster than it's original counterpart.
[*] New Weapon! Try out the Olympian! An automatic shotgun that packs some serious firepower!
[*] New Weapon! Try out the Ritual Blade! A fast stabbing dark blade resonating with power!
[*] Space Pistol Remastered
[*] New Spec Ops SMG Skin: Golden
[*] New Space Pistol Skin: Electric
[*] New Duality Knife Skin: Golden
[*] New Super Shocker Skin: Hypnotic
[*] New Cybernetic Pulsar Skin: Golden
[*] New Revolver Skin: Golden
[*] New AK-47 Skin: Golden
[*] New Double Barreled Shotgun Skin: Golden
[*] New Ratio Rifle Skin: Golden
[*] New Cyber Inferno Skin: Golden

[*] New Royal Assailant Skin: Golden

[*] New Sidearm Shotgun Skin: Golden

[*] New Ion Shotgun Skin: Ultimate
[*] New Ion Shotgun Skin: Golden
[*] Adjusted the Appearance of the Enchanted Rifle Golden Skin
[*] New Lobby
[*] New Look! Open the Game and experience a whole new UI!
[*] New Map: Cargo! (Duels and Deathmatch Only)
[*] Removed Pixel Manor from Deathmatch and Duels
[*] Removed Space Station from Duels
[*] Fixed an Issue on Windows where water would appear as a solid color.
[*] Scopes Now Ease In
[*] Game will No Longer Crash on close
[*] Steam Deck Weapon Switching should no longer be mirrored by default
[*] Sensitivity is now rounded to the nearest tenth to improve precision
[*] You now have more control over skin rotation in the skin creator
[*] Fixed an issue where some players would seem to be holding 2 weapons
[*] Fixed an issue where reloading a gun would play the sound twice sometimes
[*] Fixed an issue where Pixel Manor Lighting would appear blotchy
[*] Angels will now spawn where a Player gets eliminated
[*] Added a Kill Feed
[*] Added Chat
[*] Adjusted the appearance of Clouds
[*] Improved Air Strafing
[*] Improved Jump Mechanics
[*] Player Traction Increased
[*] Player Edge Handling Improved
[*] Player Collider Radius Increased
[*] Player Collider Height Decreased
[*] Improved Outer Environment on some Maps
[*] Fixed an issue where the Jack-O-Sniper did not emit sparks when hitting an object
[*] Added Motion Blur
[*] Added a setting to remove or adjust the intensity of Motion Blur
[*] Added a setting to adjust the quality of Motion Blur
[*] General Optimization
[*] Royal Assailant Black Neon Weapon Skin Adjusted
[*] Added import option for Custom Skins
[*] Added delete option for Custom Skins
[*] Fixed an issue where water would seem to disappear from River Battlefield and Night Battlefield
[*] Cyber Inferno has received a new Shoot Sound
[*] Improved the Ratio Rifle Magazine Shape
[*] Fixed an issue where the Double Rage image appeared to be missing a magazine
[*] Mobile Ad Gem Rewards increased to 3
[*] Fixed an issue where rounds would never end
[*] Added a sound for Defeat, Draw, and Victory
[*] Improved the Loading Screens
[*] Improved the sensitivity of the volume sliders
[*] Changed the default lobby music to Dubstep
[*] Fixed an issue where clicking on an empty skin container would remove your currently selected skin
[*] On Mobile, weapon cells can now be moved and scaled individually
[*] Adjusted the length of some end game animations
[*] On Mobile, the List of Players in a match can now be seen
[*] Updated the Player Model to Have a Wider Neck and more accurate Mesh Deformation
[*] Adjusted the appearance of water to look more lively
[*] On Mobile, you can now adjust the position of each weapon icon for better control customization
[/list]
